purpose: Card grid of courses or services with duration, price/fee range, audience and a per-card enquiry CTA that links to the enquiry form.

courseOptions.description: Optional names to configure separately in the enquiry-form selector; service cards do not pre-select them

configurationFields.description: Planned option to hide prices; not supported by the current template
Planned layout option; the current template renders cards only

testCases.description: Render three services from the sample intake
testCases.expectedOutcome: Three cards with name, duration and price exactly as supplied

testCases.description: Click 'Ask about this service' on a card
testCases.expectedOutcome: Navigates to the enquiry form; the service is not pre-selected

testCases.description: Render a service without a price value
testCases.expectedOutcome: No price text appears on that service card

knownLimitations: The current Angular template renders service cards and links each CTA to the enquiry form. It does not pre-select the service or implement the showPrices/layout configuration fields; those are not supported until implemented and tested.
Services rendered without horizontal overflow at 390px in a fictional-tenant browser run; live client configuration remains unverified.
rollbackApproach: Disable the module in site.config.json enabledModules and redeploy, or redeploy the previous build.

implementation.verifiedBy: Angular unit tests and production build in CI; a fictional-tenant browser render check passed locally
